nl: What is the dwell time, in seconds, of the attack — the elapsed time between the first and last event of the chain? Return the number of seconds.
schema:
Tables (DuckDB, OCSF fidelity store):
  f_auth(event_uid, class_uid, time, logged_time, user_uid, src_country, src_ip, outcome, is_success, is_remote, target_host)
  f_session(event_uid, user_uid, host, start_time, end_time, time, logged_time)
  f_network(event_uid, class_uid, time, logged_time, src_ip, src_hostname, dst_ip, dst_port, protocol_name, bytes_out, bytes_in, duration)
  f_dns(event_uid, class_uid, time, src_ip, src_hostname, query_hostname, answer)
  f_process(event_uid, class_uid, time, logged_time, device_hostname, actor_user_uid, image_name, cmd_line, parent_image_name, pid)
  f_api(event_uid, class_uid, time, logged_time, service, api_operation, actor_user_uid, src_ip, resource, mfa_present, mfa_value, aws_region)
  f_asset(hostname, ip, instance_uid, canonical_asset)  -- v2 12-asset population
